how: Ministries that travel to churches, each checked on its own public pages and on a church body that lists it (a church entity, an ASI member, or a church page that names it). Contact details are the ministry's own published ones; emails naming one staff member were left out. Gathered for v10.58.0 (7 Oct 2026); every link opened that day (two refuse automated readers and open in a browser).

entries.name: Messiah's Mansion
entries.what: A life-size, walk-through replica of the Mosaic sanctuary set up at your church, with free guided tours for the public.
entries.whatEs: Una réplica del santuario de Moisés a tamaño real, que se recorre a pie, instalada en su iglesia con visitas guiadas gratuitas para el público.
entries.region: National: travels around the U.S. (based in Harrah, Oklahoma)
entries.cost: Tours are free to visitors. The ministry's site lists no hosting fee (ask). In 2019, Anchorage churches set a budget to move the exhibit and staff from Oklahoma, and the Alaska Conference covered up to half of it.
entries.notes: Plan about a year ahead; its schedule is booked into mid-2027. It needs an outdoor site with parking and takes nearly 3 days to set up (750 ground stakes).

entries.name: Andrews Academy music groups
entries.what: Andrews Academy music groups perform in local churches and travel on music trips in the U.S. and Canada.
entries.whatEs: Los grupos musicales de Andrews Academy se presentan en iglesias locales y viajan en giras musicales por EE. UU. y Canadá.
entries.who: Andrews Academy (secondary school of Andrews University)
entries.region: Berrien Springs, Michigan; trips in the U.S. and Canada
entries.notes: No request form found; contact the academy office.

entries.name: Andrews University Singers & Wind Symphony
entries.what: The University Singers (select choir) and the Wind Symphony bring sacred choral and band music; the Wind Symphony travels across the Great Lakes area.
entries.whatEs: Los University Singers (coro selecto) y la Wind Symphony ofrecen música sacra coral y de banda; la Wind Symphony viaja por la región de los Grandes Lagos.
entries.region: Great Lakes area (Wind Symphony); the Singers tour nationally and abroad
entries.notes: No booking form found; ask the Department of Music.

entries.name: Auburn Adventist Academy music ensembles
entries.what: Sylvan Chorale, the Wind Ensemble and Tintinnabulation perform at churches and schools and take a week-long tour each year.
entries.whatEs: Sylvan Chorale, el Wind Ensemble y Tintinnabulation se presentan en iglesias y escuelas y hacen una gira de una semana cada año.
entries.region: Auburn, Washington; yearly week-long tour (recent: Orlando, Boston, New York City, western Canada)
entries.notes: No request form found; contact the school office.

entries.name: Blue Mountain Academy tour groups
entries.what: La Sonnette handbell ensemble and Bel Canto, a 32-voice choir, visit churches, schools and events as BMA mission tour groups.
entries.whatEs: El conjunto de campanas La Sonnette y Bel Canto, un coro de 32 voces, visitan iglesias, escuelas y eventos como grupos misioneros de BMA.
entries.region: Pennsylvania and nearby mid-Atlantic states; also international tours
entries.notes: The page asks you to contact the school to arrange a visit to your church. La Sonnette tours the mid-Atlantic about once a month. BMA also has a touring acrobatic team.

entries.name: Campion Academy music ensembles
entries.what: Koinonia select choir, Symphony, Teh Campanas handbells and Jazz Band perform locally and on music tours.
entries.whatEs: El coro selecto Koinonia, la Sinfónica, las campanas Teh Campanas y la banda de jazz se presentan localmente y en giras musicales.
entries.region: Based in Loveland, Colorado; music tours (areas not stated)
entries.notes: No request form found; contact the school office.

entries.name: Collegedale Academy music groups
entries.what: Choirs (OPUS, Choral Union), bands and orchestra regularly perform at local churches and go on tours.
entries.whatEs: Los coros (OPUS, Choral Union), las bandas y la orquesta se presentan con frecuencia en iglesias locales y salen de gira.
entries.region: Collegedale, Tennessee area; tours have gone to Boston, Savannah, Chicago, Puerto Rico and Europe
entries.notes: K-12 school next to Southern Adventist University. No request form found; contact the school office.

entries.name: Fletcher Academy music groups (11th Hour)
entries.what: Fletcher music groups, including the 11th Hour touring select choir, perform in local churches and go on multi-state tours each year.
entries.whatEs: Los grupos musicales de Fletcher, incluido el coro selecto de gira 11th Hour, se presentan en iglesias locales y hacen giras por varios estados cada año.
entries.region: Based in Fletcher, North Carolina; multi-state and sometimes international tours
entries.notes: Self-supporting academy (ASI member). No request form found; contact the school office.

entries.name: Fountainview Academy Orchestra and Singers
entries.what: Fountainview's orchestra and singers give concerts of sacred music in churches, schools and concert halls across Canada and the U.S.
entries.whatEs: La orquesta y los cantantes de Fountainview ofrecen conciertos de música sacra en iglesias, escuelas y salas de concierto de Canadá y EE. UU.
entries.region: Canada and the United States
entries.notes: Canadian school that tours the U.S. The concert request form asks whether the students could stay overnight at your church, gym or a nearby venue after the concert.

entries.name: Gem State Adventist Academy music groups
entries.what: Chorale (touring choir), Soundwave handbells and Concert Band bring worship music to churches and events across the Northwest.
entries.whatEs: Chorale (coro de gira), las campanas Soundwave y la banda de concierto llevan música de adoración a iglesias y eventos del Noroeste.
entries.region: Idaho and the Northwest
entries.notes: The music page says to contact the music director (his school email is printed there) to have a group perform at your event. Concert Band makes a long Northwest tour every other year.

entries.name: Georgia-Cumberland Academy music groups
entries.what: Camerata, Chorale, Concert Band, Orchestra, Sinfonietta and Magnify Worship tour area churches and schools during the year.
entries.whatEs: Camerata, Chorale, la banda, la orquesta, Sinfonietta y Magnify Worship visitan iglesias y escuelas de la zona durante el año.
entries.region: Calhoun, Georgia and surrounding area; extended tour every other year
entries.notes: Extended tour every other year during the April home leave. No request form found; call the academy.

entries.name: Great Lakes Adventist Academy music ensembles
entries.what: Chambers & Bells (choir and handbells) and Winds & Strings (band and orchestra) visit churches, schools and venues on tour.
entries.whatEs: Chambers & Bells (coro y campanas) y Winds & Strings (banda y orquesta) visitan iglesias, escuelas y otros lugares en sus giras.
entries.region: Michigan weekend tours plus an annual week-long out-of-state tour
entries.notes: Two request routes on the music page: Chambers & Bells by the staff email printed there; Winds & Strings by a Google 'Visit Request Form'. The form says the calendar fills up quickly.

entries.name: ICantori of Walla Walla University
entries.what: ICantori, Walla Walla University's select choir, sings sacred choral music for church services, vespers and concerts on its yearly tour.
entries.whatEs: ICantori, el coro selecto de Walla Walla University, canta música coral sacra en cultos, vísperas y conciertos durante su gira anual.
entries.region: Pacific Northwest and western U.S. (2026 tour: Southern California)
entries.cost: The page says tours are funded by the university and by donations to the ICantori Tour Fund.
entries.notes: Spring tour in March (2026 itinerary included Adventist churches and Loma Linda Academy). The Symphony Orchestra and Wind Symphony also list church performances and some touring.

entries.name: Lodi Academy Lodian Singers and Concert Band
entries.what: The Lodian Singers and Concert Band perform at local churches and community programs and take one longer tour each year.
entries.whatEs: Los Lodian Singers y la banda de concierto se presentan en iglesias locales y programas comunitarios y hacen una gira larga cada año.
entries.region: Lodi, California (Northern California Conference)
entries.notes: Day school. No request form found; contact the school or the musical director.

entries.name: Milo Adventist Academy music tours
entries.what: The choir, One Voice select choir and other ensembles go on music tours, performing at schools and churches.
entries.whatEs: El coro, el coro selecto One Voice y otros conjuntos hacen giras musicales y se presentan en escuelas e iglesias.
entries.region: Based in Days Creek, Oregon; tour areas not stated
entries.notes: No request form found; use the school's contact form or phone.

entries.name: Oklahoma Academy choir, strings and bells
entries.what: The Choir, String Ensemble and Bell Choir travel to share the gospel in music; churches can request a concert online.
entries.whatEs: El coro, el conjunto de cuerdas y el coro de campanas viajan para compartir el evangelio con música; las iglesias pueden pedir un concierto en línea.
entries.region: Based in Harrah, Oklahoma; travels in the U.S. and abroad
entries.notes: Self-supporting academy (ASI member). Music page has a 'Request a Concert in Your Church' form.

entries.name: Ozark Adventist Academy choirs and orchestra
entries.what: The choir, select concert choir and orchestra perform sacred music at churches, school events and community programs.
entries.whatEs: El coro, el coro selecto de concierto y la orquesta presentan música sacra en iglesias, actos escolares y programas comunitarios.
entries.region: Gentry, Arkansas and the surrounding area
entries.notes: No request form found; contact the school or the music director.

entries.name: Pine Forge Academy Choir
entries.what: The Pine Forge Academy Choir sings spirituals, gospel, anthems and classical music at church services, concerts and on tour.
entries.whatEs: El coro de Pine Forge Academy canta espirituales, góspel, himnos y música clásica en cultos, conciertos y giras.
entries.region: Based in Pine Forge, Pennsylvania; has sung across the continental U.S. and abroad
entries.notes: During the school year the choir does concerts, church services and tours several times a month. The Performing Arts page prints the choir's booking contact.

entries.name: Portland Adventist Academy music ensembles
entries.what: Five ensembles (Choir, Alegria, Band, Bell Canto handbells, PASO) lead Featured Church services and go on a spring music tour.
entries.whatEs: Cinco conjuntos (Coro, Alegria, Banda, campanas Bell Canto y PASO) dirigen cultos especiales en iglesias y hacen una gira musical en primavera.
entries.region: Portland, Oregon; spring tour (2026: Oregon to the San Francisco Bay Area)
entries.notes: No request form found; contact the school office.

entries.name: Shenandoah Valley Academy Shenandoans and Orchestra
entries.what: The Shenandoans touring choir and the touring SVA Orchestra share sacred choral and orchestral music; a handbell ensemble also performs.
entries.whatEs: El coro de gira Shenandoans y la orquesta de gira de SVA comparten música sacra coral y orquestal; también hay un conjunto de campanas.
entries.region: Based in New Market, Virginia; tour areas not stated on the page
entries.notes: No request form found; call the academy. The handbell ensemble attends RingFest in Toledo, Ohio each year.

entries.name: Southern Adventist University School of Music ensembles
entries.what: Wind Symphony, Symphony Orchestra and I Cantori chamber choir share sacred and classical music on short concert tours each year.
entries.whatEs: La Wind Symphony, la Orquesta Sinfónica y el coro de cámara I Cantori comparten música sacra y clásica en breves giras de conciertos cada año.
entries.region: Based in Collegedale, Tennessee; domestic tours, with an extended or international tour every third year
entries.notes: No request form found; contact the School of Music office. Wind Symphony gives two three-day tours a year; the orchestra does a couple of concert tours a year.

entries.name: Spring Valley Academy choir and band
entries.what: The high school choir and concert band sing and play for Sabbath services at area churches and take one major tour each year.
entries.whatEs: El coro y la banda de secundaria cantan y tocan en los cultos del sábado en iglesias de la zona y hacen una gira importante cada año.
entries.region: Centerville (Dayton), Ohio and surrounding area
entries.notes: K-12 day school; junior high choir and band also sing at area churches. No request form found; call the school.

entries.name: The Aeolians of Oakwood University
entries.what: The Aeolians, Oakwood's award-winning concert choir, sing spirituals, classical and sacred choral music in concerts and at churches.
entries.whatEs: Los Aeolians, el galardonado coro de concierto de Oakwood, cantan espirituales negros y música coral clásica y sacra en conciertos e iglesias.
entries.region: National (based in Huntsville, Alabama; the choir tours extensively)
entries.notes: Home page invites you to 'Book your concert experience' through its contact form; 2025-26 calendar lists church concerts.

entries.name: The University Singers of Southwestern Adventist University
entries.what: The University Singers, SWAU's touring choir, travel during the semester to sing at churches, conferences and special events.
entries.whatEs: The University Singers, el coro de gira de SWAU, viajan durante el semestre para cantar en iglesias, congresos y eventos especiales.
entries.region: National and international (based in Keene, Texas)
entries.notes: The University Singers page prints the director's contact for 'Membership, Donations or Invitations'; use that page to reach him.

entries.name: Thunderbird Adventist Academy music groups
entries.what: Band, handbells, jazz band, choir and chorale travel to perform around Arizona and beyond; churches can request a concert.
entries.whatEs: La banda, las campanas, la banda de jazz, el coro y el coral viajan para presentarse en Arizona y otros lugares; las iglesias pueden pedir un concierto.
entries.region: Arizona and beyond (based in Scottsdale, Arizona)
entries.notes: Music page has a 'Request a Concert in Your Church' form.

entries.name: Union Adventist University music groups (Unionaires and others)
entries.what: The Unionaires choir, Union Singers, Concert Winds band and Golden Chords string quartet sing and play in churches and on Midwest tours.
entries.whatEs: El coro Unionaires, los Union Singers, la banda Concert Winds y el cuarteto de cuerdas Golden Chords tocan y cantan en iglesias y en giras por el Medio Oeste.
entries.region: Midwest (based in Lincoln, Nebraska); Unionaires have also toured both coasts
entries.notes: Unionaires take tours and trips each semester; Concert Winds play at Lincoln-area churches; Golden Chords tour the Midwest.

entries.name: Committed
entries.what: Adventist a cappella gospel group, winners of NBC's The Sing-Off (season 2), available for concerts.
entries.whatEs: Grupo adventista de góspel a capela, ganador de The Sing-Off de NBC (segunda temporada), disponible para conciertos.
entries.notes: Booking and press inquiries go through the form on the booking page. The site's tour-dates page currently lists no dates.

entries.name: Heritage Singers
entries.what: Gospel vocal group that brings full concerts of traditional and contemporary gospel songs to churches.
entries.whatEs: Grupo vocal de góspel que lleva a las iglesias conciertos completos de cantos góspel tradicionales y contemporáneos.
entries.region: national (based in Placerville, California; has toured 80+ countries)
entries.notes: Office hours Mon–Thu 9:30–5:00 Pacific (closed Fridays); contact is by phone or web form. Concerts page lists upcoming dates at Adventist churches and has a 'Request a show' button.

entries.name: Jaime Jorge (violinist)
entries.what: Concert violinist who brings sacred music concerts to churches and tours widely across the United States.
entries.whatEs: Violinista de concierto que lleva conciertos de música sacra a las iglesias y realiza giras por todo Estados Unidos.
entries.region: national (based in Ooltewah, Tennessee)
entries.cost: Tour listings show many church concerts as free; no fee schedule is published.
entries.notes: Tour dates show where he is already touring, which can help fit a church onto a route.

entries.name: Jennifer LaMountain
entries.what: Gospel recording artist who gives concerts in churches and at camp meetings.
entries.whatEs: Cantante de góspel con varias grabaciones que ofrece conciertos en iglesias y en reuniones campestres.
entries.region: national (based in Florida)

entries.name: The King's Heralds
entries.what: Male a cappella gospel quartet (founded 1927) that comes to churches for sacred concerts.
entries.whatEs: Cuarteto masculino de góspel a capela (fundado en 1927) que visita iglesias para ofrecer conciertos de música sacra.
entries.region: national (office in Portland, Tennessee)
entries.notes: Use the 'Book A Concert' form under Booking on the contact page.

entries.name: 1888 Message Study Committee
entries.what: Righteousness-by-faith seminars, weekend conferences or a week of prayer at your church or school (covenants, sanctuary, etc.).
entries.whatEs: Seminarios sobre la justificación por la fe, conferencias de fin de semana o semana de oración en su iglesia o escuela (pactos, santuario, etc.).
entries.cost: Requesting church pays speaker travel and provides lodging and meals (usually in a member's home); freewill offerings to 1888 Glad Tidings.
entries.notes: Pastor or head elder sends a letter of request by email or post with topic, preferred and alternate dates, length (weekend, one week) and any speaker preference.

entries.name: Amazing Facts Center of Evangelism (AFCOE) – Request a Speaker
entries.what: Amazing Facts evangelists (currently Carlos Muñoz and Daniel Hudgens) come to preach at your event; request by date and city.
entries.whatEs: Evangelistas de Amazing Facts (actualmente Carlos Muñoz y Daniel Hudgens) vienen a predicar en su evento; se solicitan por fecha y ciudad.
entries.region: national (form also accepts other countries)
entries.notes: Online form asks for speaker, city, country/state, start and end dates and a description of the event.

entries.name: Breath of Life Ministries
entries.what: NAD media ministry; Pastor Debleaire Snell preaches Sabbath and weekend events at local churches across the U.S.
entries.whatEs: Ministerio de medios de la División Norteamericana; el pastor Debleaire Snell predica en sábados y fines de semana en iglesias locales de EE. UU.
entries.region: national
entries.notes: No booking form; its speaker schedule shows the churches it visits. Office hours Mon–Thu 9–5 (Central). Urban and contemporary focus.

entries.name: Escrito Está (It Is Written en español)
entries.what: Spanish ministry of It Is Written; speaker Robert Costa holds evangelistic series and rallies for Hispanic churches.
entries.whatEs: Ministerio en español de It Is Written; el orador Robert Costa realiza campañas evangelísticas y concentraciones para iglesias hispanas.
entries.who: It Is Written (North American Division media ministry)
entries.region: national (also international)
entries.notes: Spanish-language. No booking form; its itinerary is on its news and events page. Contact the office to ask about a campaign. The Spanish ministry of It Is Written.

entries.name: Forever Free Ministries (Amazing Prophecies)
entries.what: Mark Fox presents Amazing Prophecies seminars or revival weekends for churches in the U.S. and Canada.
entries.whatEs: Mark Fox presenta seminarios de profecía Amazing Prophecies o fines de semana de avivamiento para iglesias en EE. UU. y Canadá.
entries.region: United States and Canada
entries.notes: Request form is on the Events page. Toll-free number is printed on the Contact and About pages; serves the United States and Canada. Office in Weatherford, TX.

entries.name: It Is Written
entries.what: NAD media ministry whose speakers (John Bradshaw, Eric Flickinger) hold evangelistic series and weekend events across the U.S.
entries.whatEs: Ministerio de medios de la DNA cuyos oradores (John Bradshaw, Eric Flickinger) dan series evangelísticas y eventos de fin de semana en EE. UU.
entries.region: national
entries.notes: No public booking form; current itinerary is on the Speaker Schedules page. Call the office or use the contact form to ask about hosting.

entries.name: Jesus 101 Biblical Institute
entries.what: NAD media ministry; speaker Dr. Elizabeth Talbot preaches Christ-centered Bible messages at local churches and events.
entries.whatEs: Ministerio de medios de la División Norteamericana; la Dra. Elizabeth Talbot predica mensajes bíblicos centrados en Cristo en iglesias y eventos.
entries.region: national (current events mostly in California)
entries.notes: No booking form; its events page shows speaking dates at Adventist churches. Ask through the contact form or the office.

entries.name: La Voz del Consolador
entries.what: Spanish-language Adventist ministry; speaker Andrés Portes preaches campaigns and revival meetings for Hispanic churches.
entries.whatEs: Ministerio adventista en español; el orador Andrés Portes predica campañas y reuniones de avivamiento para iglesias hispanas.
entries.region: national (based in Houston, TX; also international)
entries.notes: Spanish-language. Its contact form has an “Invitación” option.

entries.name: Light Bearers
entries.what: Speakers (Ty Gibson, David Asscherick, Angelo Grasso, Jeffrey Rosario) for worship, revival, evangelistic, training and youth events.
entries.whatEs: Oradores (Ty Gibson, David Asscherick, Angelo Grasso, Jeffrey Rosario) para cultos, avivamientos, campañas, capacitación y eventos juveniles.
entries.region: national
entries.cost: Inviting organization is responsible for all travel expenses (reimbursed); event length affects costs.
entries.notes: Speaker calendar is full for 2026; requests are taken for 2027 and beyond. Form asks about church/conference and pastoral/board support.

entries.name: North American Division Evangelism Institute (NADEI)
entries.what: NAD training institute; brings evangelism field schools, small-group training weekends and church planting/revitalization help.
entries.whatEs: Instituto de la DNA; ofrece escuelas de evangelismo, fines de semana de capacitación en grupos pequeños y ayuda para plantar o revitalizar iglesias.
entries.region: NAD-wide (arranged with unions and conferences)
entries.notes: A conference can invite an Evangelism Institute professor to be the evangelist for a series (a field school with Andrews seminary students). Ask your conference.

entries.name: Pathway to Paradise Ministries
entries.what: Public evangelistic campaigns, church revival weekends and practical Bible-study courses at your church or community.
entries.whatEs: Campañas evangelísticas públicas, fines de semana de avivamiento y cursos prácticos de estudio bíblico en su iglesia o comunidad.
entries.notes: To schedule, call or leave a message (855-HIS-TRUTH). Its seminars are listed on its site.

entries.name: Revelation of Love Ministries
entries.what: Evangelist David Machado brings reaping meetings, revival series, SHINE soul-winning training or a 3-week Bible prophecy seminar.
entries.whatEs: El evangelista David Machado ofrece reuniones de cosecha, series de avivamiento, capacitación SHINE para ganar almas o un seminario de profecía de 3 semanas.
entries.region: national (also international)
entries.notes: Series lengths: reaping 7 parts, revival 7 or 10 parts, SHINE 10 parts, Revelation of Love prophecy seminar 3 weeks/4 weekends (21 messages). Request form is on the same page.

entries.name: Secrets Unsealed
entries.what: Prophecy and Bible seminars with Pastor Stephen Bohr, Pastor C.A. Murray or Pastor David Salazar (Spanish), in person or online.
entries.whatEs: Seminarios de profecía y Biblia con el pastor Stephen Bohr, el pastor C.A. Murray o el pastor David Salazar (en español), presenciales o en línea.
entries.region: national
entries.cost: Inviting church pays all travel (airfare, rental car, hotel, gasoline) and a daily per diem; honorariums not required but appreciated.

entries.name: White Horse Media
entries.what: Steve Wohlberg (or associate speakers) leads Bible prophecy revival or outreach weekends, mini-series and camp meetings.
entries.whatEs: Steve Wohlberg (u oradores asociados) dirige fines de semana de profecía bíblica para avivamiento o alcance, miniseries y campestres.
entries.region: national (North America and overseas)
entries.cost: Per its seminar request sheet: travel for the speaker and event coordinator (hotel, car, meals), a $1,500 speaker fee, one offering for the ministry and a book sale; a deposit secures the date.
entries.notes: Church provides projector and microphone, Sabbath lunch and a light supper, and one seminar coordinator. A typical weekend is 3–4 talks, Friday to Sabbath.

entries.name: AMEN Free Clinics (Adventist Medical Evangelism Network)
entries.what: Runs a free medical, dental and vision clinic with your church for uninsured neighbors, as a doorway to follow-up health and Bible programs.
entries.whatEs: Organiza con su iglesia una clínica gratuita médica, dental y de la vista para vecinos sin seguro, como puerta a programas de salud y de estudio bíblico.
entries.who: Adventist Medical Evangelism Network (AMEN), an independent supporting ministry (Ooltewah, Tenn.)
entries.region: national (U.S.)
entries.cost: Free for patients. Volunteers pay their own travel and lodging. Cost to the host church is not stated.
entries.notes: Choose "Schedule a Clinic" on the interest form; a team member then contacts you. AMEN says clinics work best when followed by follow-up events and an evangelistic series.

entries.name: Chef Mark Anthony – Healthy Cooking Classes
entries.what: Brings live plant-based cooking classes and health talks to your church; also does full camp-meeting programs.
entries.whatEs: Lleva a su iglesia clases de cocina saludable a base de plantas y charlas de salud; también ofrece programas completos para reuniones campestres.
entries.region: national (says he has presented in every U.S. state)
entries.notes: One presenter, not a team. His site says to book early for camp meetings. Standing rests on the Wisconsin Conference health page listing him among health programs (a link, not a formal endorsement).

entries.name: Nedley Health – Depression & Anxiety Recovery (Dr. Neil Nedley)
entries.what: Dr. Neil Nedley speaks at churches on depression, anxiety and the brain; your church can also host his 8-week recovery program.
entries.whatEs: El Dr. Neil Nedley da charlas en iglesias sobre la depresión, la ansiedad y el cerebro; su iglesia también puede ofrecer su programa de recuperación de 8 semanas.
entries.region: national (live and virtual events "around the globe")
entries.notes: Use the "Speaker Request Form" linked on the Events page. For the 8-week community program, your own members are trained to lead it (see "Lead a Community Program" on the site).

entries.name: Uchee Pines Institute – Health Emphasis Weekend
entries.what: Brings a 1- to 3-day health weekend to your church: 8 laws of health, home remedies with demos, and a cooking school or community health expo.
entries.whatEs: Lleva a su iglesia un fin de semana de salud de 1 a 3 días: las 8 leyes de la salud, remedios caseros con demostraciones y clases de cocina o una feria de salud.
entries.region: national ("venues across the country")
entries.cost: Free-will offering requested, plus permission to sell books and materials on Sunday; travel $0.50 per mile round trip from Uchee Pines, or air travel costs.
entries.notes: Church or group provides accommodations and food for the team.

entries.name: Wildwood Health Institute – Health Emphasis Weekends (HEWS)
entries.what: Brings a half-day, full-day or weekend health seminar or expo to your church: talks, cooking school, natural remedies and consultations.
entries.whatEs: Lleva a su iglesia un seminario o feria de salud de medio día, día completo o fin de semana: charlas, clases de cocina, remedios naturales y consultas.
entries.who: Wildwood Health Institute (Wildwood, Georgia), a supporting ministry of the Seventh-day Adventist Church
entries.region: national (travels from Wildwood, Ga.; host pays mileage or airfare)
entries.cost: No fees. They ask to take a love offering and sell health materials; travel reimbursement ($0.60 per mile or airfare); $500 deposit if a cooking school is included.
entries.notes: Church provides lodging, plant-based meals, local transportation, basic event equipment and the food used in demos. Online application takes 10–20 minutes (or call).

entries.name: Andrews University Gymnics
entries.what: Traveling acrosport gymnastics team giving hour-long shows with anti-drug and anti-bullying messages for youth groups, schools and academy vespers.
entries.whatEs: Equipo itinerante de gimnasia acrobática con espectáculos de una hora y mensajes contra las drogas y el acoso para grupos juveniles, escuelas y vísperas.
entries.region: Mostly southern Michigan, northern Indiana and Illinois; has traveled farther
entries.notes: A performance ministry, not a preaching team. Page names youth groups, academies, public-school rallies, and vespers and church services at academies; book a tour by email or phone.

entries.name: Camp Texico On the Go (traveling day camp)
entries.what: Conference camp staff bring a Christ-centered day camp to your church: games, activities, worship and Bible lessons for children and families.
entries.whatEs: El personal del campamento lleva a su iglesia un campamento de día centrado en Cristo: juegos, actividades, culto y lecciones bíblicas para niños y familias.
entries.who: Texico Conference of Seventh-day Adventists, Youth & Young Adult Ministries
entries.region: Texico Conference (New Mexico and West Texas)
entries.notes: Summer only.

entries.name: Feeding His Lambs Ministries
entries.what: Lisa Quade leads children's evangelistic programs alongside adult meetings, camp-meeting and VBS programs, and child-evangelism training workshops.
entries.whatEs: Lisa Quade dirige programas evangelísticos infantiles junto a reuniones de adultos, programas de campestre y EBV, y talleres de evangelismo infantil.
entries.region: North America and abroad (travels on request)
entries.notes: Use the contact form on its site to invite them. Teaches from the KJV.

entries.name: In Discipleship
entries.what: Revivals and discipleship training for parents, mentors, teachers and children (e.g., Footprints for Kids, Schools in Discipleship) in your church.
entries.whatEs: Avivamientos y capacitación en discipulado para padres, mentores, maestros y niños (p. ej., Footprints for Kids, Schools in Discipleship) en su iglesia.
entries.region: national and international
entries.cost: No charge for instruction, training, books, resources or meals; at some venues attendees cover their own lodging; love gifts welcome.
entries.notes: Volunteer faith ministry with no paid staff.

entries.name: SOULS West evangelistic team
entries.what: Staff-and-student outreach team that trains members, shares literature, gives Bible studies, helps run a reaping series and leads youth vespers.
entries.whatEs: Equipo de personal y estudiantes que capacita miembros, reparte literatura, da estudios bíblicos, apoya una serie de cosecha y dirige vísperas juveniles.
entries.who: Pacific Union Conference of Seventh-day Adventists (owns and operates SOULS West)
entries.region: Pacific Union (Arizona, California, Hawaii, Nevada, Utah)
entries.cost: Invite page lists 'funding for the program' among what the host church provides; amount not stated.

entries.name: Youth Rush Michigan (vespers visits)
entries.what: Sends a Youth Rush student team member to run a youth vespers program at your church, school or Pathfinder club, food included.
entries.whatEs: Envía a un estudiante de Youth Rush a dirigir un programa de vísperas juvenil en su iglesia, escuela o club de Conquistadores, con comida incluida.
entries.who: Michigan Conference of Seventh-day Adventists, Literature Ministries Department
entries.region: Lake Union (outside the Lake Union, case by case)
entries.cost: FAQ says food is included; no fee stated.
entries.notes: Youth Rush itself is the conference's 10-week summer student literature-evangelism program (early June to mid-August).

entries.name: Carolina Conference Family Ministries
entries.what: Conference department offering marriage and parenting seminars, Family Emphasis Sabbaths, divorce recovery and camp-meeting seminars.
entries.whatEs: Departamento de la asociación que ofrece seminarios de matrimonio y crianza, sábados de énfasis familiar, recuperación tras el divorcio y seminarios en el campestre.
entries.region: Carolina Conference (the Carolinas)
entries.notes: Also runs the 'Romance at the Ranch' marriage retreat (February, Nosoca Pines Ranch) and lends resources to families and pastors at no charge.

entries.name: Michigan Conference Family Ministries
entries.what: Conference department that partners with local churches through retreats, seminars and training on marriage, parenting and home life.
entries.whatEs: Departamento de la asociación que colabora con las iglesias locales mediante retiros, seminarios y capacitación sobre matrimonio, crianza y vida en el hogar.
entries.region: Michigan Conference
entries.notes: Has a seminar menu (marriage, parenting, money management, faith at home). A Spanish newsletter is offered.

entries.name: NAD Family Ministries
entries.what: Division family department; its directors can be invited to speak on marriage and family, and it links you to your conference family director.
entries.whatEs: Departamento de familia de la División; se puede invitar a sus directores a hablar sobre matrimonio y familia, y le conecta con el director de familia de su asociación.
entries.who: North American Division of Seventh-day Adventists
entries.region: national (North American Division)
entries.notes: The NAD’s family directors are usually booked 12–15 months ahead; invite nearby churches or plan an area-wide event.

entries.name: Northern New England Conference Family Ministries
entries.what: Conference family team that preaches Sabbath sermons and leads family weekends and marriage enrichment seminars at churches.
entries.whatEs: Equipo de familia de la asociación que predica en el culto de sábado y dirige fines de semana familiares y seminarios de enriquecimiento matrimonial en las iglesias.
entries.who: Northern New England Conference of Seventh-day Adventists
entries.region: Northern New England Conference
entries.notes: The page says to contact them early because the calendar fills quickly.

entries.name: Adventist Frontier Missions
entries.what: Missionary speakers for weekend mission-promotion events, and trainers for weekend or week-long disciple-making training at your church.
entries.whatEs: Misioneros para eventos de promoción misionera de fin de semana y capacitadores para entrenamientos de discipulado de un fin de semana o una semana en su iglesia.
entries.cost: Weekend mission-promotion events: church covers travel, room and board (a donation to AFM is appreciated). Training events: travel, room and board; registration fees case by case. Consulting: $1,000 per day per trainer.
entries.notes: The FAQ says to call the AFM training department (number above) or email; the online interest form is 'coming soon'. Main office 269-473-4250, toll-free 800-937-4236. Request page:

entries.name: Adventist World Radio
entries.what: The church's international radio ministry; a staff member or volunteer can come and speak about AWR's mission at your church or event.
entries.whatEs: Ministerio radial internacional de la Iglesia; un empleado o voluntario puede visitar su iglesia o evento para hablar sobre la misión de AWR.
entries.notes: Its events page says to contact AWR if you would like a staff member or volunteer to speak at your church.

entries.name: Creation Study Center (North Pacific Union Conference)
entries.what: Dr. Stan Hudson brings a creation-and-flood seminar (dinosaurs, fossils, age of the earth) to your church; hands-on museum in Ridgefield, WA.
entries.whatEs: El Dr. Stan Hudson ofrece en su iglesia un seminario sobre la creación y el diluvio (dinosaurios, fósiles, edad de la tierra); museo en Ridgefield, WA.
entries.who: North Pacific Union Conference of Seventh-day Adventists
entries.region: North Pacific Union territory (Alaska, Idaho, Montana, Oregon, Washington)
entries.cost: No charge for churches in the Pacific Northwest; the church pays only for advertising (usually through SermonView).
entries.notes: This is a speaker's seminar, not a walk-through exhibit. Usually a weekend (Friday night and Sabbath) or a one-day series in 3 or 4 parts; book early because the schedule fills up.

entries.name: Maranatha Volunteers International
entries.what: Sends a team for a Sabbath mission program at your church: a 50-minute multimedia worship presentation plus an afternoon Q&A.
entries.whatEs: Envía un equipo para un programa misionero de sábado en su iglesia: una presentación multimedia de 50 minutos en el culto y una sesión de preguntas por la tarde.
entries.region: United States only (per the invite page)
entries.cost: No offering is taken and the church has no financial obligation; they appreciate Sabbath lunch for the team.
entries.notes: Request by the online form on the invite page; in-person or virtual programs, and the format can be adjusted.

entries.name: NAD Literature Ministries
entries.what: Division literature ministries department; preaching and seminar appointments on sharing Christian literature are available upon request.
entries.whatEs: Departamento de ministerios de publicaciones de la División; ofrece predicaciones y seminarios sobre cómo compartir literatura cristiana, a solicitud.
entries.who: North American Division of Seventh-day Adventists
entries.region: national (North American Division)

entries.name: NAD Stewardship Ministries
entries.what: Division stewardship directors give stewardship presentations at churches, such as for a Stewardship Day, on request.
entries.whatEs: Los directores de mayordomía de la División dan presentaciones sobre mayordomía en las iglesias, por ejemplo para un Día de la Mayordomía, a solicitud.
entries.who: North American Division of Seventh-day Adventists
entries.region: national (North American Division)
entries.notes: The request form asks for dates, event type and address. NAD asks you to discuss plans with your pastor and let your conference know.

entries.name: Walla Walla University Center for Bible, Faith, and Mission
entries.what: Theology professors speak at churches on Adventist history, beliefs and Bible prophecy; church leaders can request a speaker.
entries.whatEs: Profesores de teología hablan en las iglesias sobre historia adventista, creencias y profecía bíblica; los líderes de iglesia pueden solicitar un orador.
entries.who: Walla Walla University School of Theology
